audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Urgot Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item, but the packet levelChart is Skill/Swain/Swain/Skill/Swain/Swain/Skill and Swain wins the matchup at 53.03% over 132 games. The whys already describe Swain winning those rows.
audit.why: Swain's Nevermove root plus Vision of Empire slow is a stronger step-up punish than Urgot has an answer for, and Demonic Ascension sustains through Purge's sustained damage. The chart contradicted its own explanations.
audit.corrected: Rows flipped to match the packet chart and the win rate, with ratings adjusted in the same atomic group; win[] and phases[].side proposed as pairs.

audit.why: Spikes are Level 2 (Nevermove online), Level 6 (Demonic Ascension drain), first item, and the Disdain cooldown window. All four entries exist and are accurate in substance; only the Disdain cooldown number was wrong.
audit.corrected: Disdain cooldown corrected from a flat 14 s to 16 s at rank 1 scaling to 14 s maxed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly cites Disdain as a flat 14-second cooldown; that is the rank-5 value. Rank 1 is 16 s. Swain's E is also never named (Nevermove) nor is its 12 s rank-1 cooldown given.
audit.why: The brief's kit files are authority on cooldowns. Concrete numbers on both roots are what make the trade timing actionable.
audit.corrected: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14; Swain E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 and it has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension per Riot's own text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Urgot's Q with a dash flag, but Riot's description says it fires an explosive charge at a target location — no dash.
audit.why: Derived flag misfire from tooltip parsing; the description governs.
audit.corrected: No Q dash claim written anywhere in the text.

edits.before: E comes online and you can W-slow into E-root the moment he steps up for CS — one combo lets you Q-burst him and pull before he can use Disdain to reposition.
edits.after: Nevermove (E) is online: W-slow, then root as he steps up for CS — Q-burst and pull him. It is a 12 s cooldown at rank 1, so spend it on his step-up, never on the wave.

edits.before: Urgot's Disdain (E) flip is the danger — track its 14-second cooldown and only throw your E hand when it is unavailable so he cannot disengage into his W shred.
edits.after: Urgot's Disdain (E) flip is the danger — it is down 16 s at rank 1, so throw your E hand only while it is spent and he cannot flip you into his Purge shred.

edits.before: Disdain's flip is his only reliable setup for an all-in — the moment it is on cooldown (14 s) you own the window; root him before it resets.
edits.after: Disdain's flip is his only setup for an all-in — the moment it is spent (16 s at rank 1, 14 s maxed) that window is yours; root him before it resets.

notes: Urgot's Q carries a 'dash' derived flag that contradicts Riot's description (a targeted explosive charge) — no dash claim was written. Level chart flipped to match packet.levelChart and the 53.03% win rate; win[] and phases[].side proposed as matched pairs.
